planned_checks.statement: Candidate HEAD equals the packet's frozen commit and the package bytes are unchanged.
Frontmatter carries name and description only; name equals the folder name.
Every package-relative link resolves inside the package.
No runtime dependency on docs/mvp, on another skill package, or on a developer home path; no Claude shell-injection syntax.
derivation.json sources and destinations match bytes; at least five declared sources spot-checked including both template copies.
Every evals files[] entry and fixture path exists inside evals/; every deterministic_cases id exists in cases.jsonl.

Every SKILL-003 row - use-case inventory, inputs, four phases and exits, outputs, five acceptance cases, four common cases, rework, stopping, completion - is addressed, and spec-mapping.md's claims verify against bytes.
DevForge CLI references name only existing commands; missing integrations are named and routed; no self-issued PASS or simulated gate.

Candidate output quality against a without_skill baseline on the same raw facts, covering evals.json ids 2-10.
Discovery and activation from the installed package in a fresh terminal, across the 23 trigger queries with explicit and implicit kept separate.
